description: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:193-196 and pkix-revocation/src/ocsp.rs:327 — Both CrlChecker::check_revocation and OcspChecker::check_revocation call from_der() to parse the full DER on every call. For a chain of N certificates validated against the same CRL/OCSP response, this is O(N) redundant parsing. The doc comments acknowledge this (Limitations v0.1, tracked for v0.3). This is a confirmed known deferral. Filing for tracking — the fix is to parse once in new()/with_delta() and store the parsed struct. Deferring until v0.3 per the existing plan unless a profiling run shows it is the bottleneck.
title: CrlChecker re-parses DER on every check_revocation call
